sloka: अपिबत् तु जलम् सर्वम् गंगयाः परम अद्भुतम् ।ततो देवाः स गंघर्व ऋषयः च सु विस्मिताः ॥१-४३-३५॥
transliteration: apibat tu jalam sarvam gaṁgayāḥ parama adbhutam ।tato devāḥ sa gaṁgharva ṛṣayaḥ ca su vismitāḥ ॥1-43-35॥

translations.english: O Descendant of the Raghu dynasty sage Jahnu who was performing the sacrifice, observed her pride and grew furious. And astonishingly drank the entire waters of Ganga.
